lemmas.primary_translation: to get used to the conditions

definitions.translation: become accustomed to the circumstances (lit. become warm in the jersey)

examples.no: hun begynte for kun en uke siden, så hun er ikke helt varm i trøya ennå
examples.en: she only started a week ago, so she has not quite got used to the circumstances yet

examples.no: de nye folkene har vært her en stund nå, så de begynnger å bli varme i trøya
examples.en: the new people have been here for a while now, so they are beginning to get used to the circumstances
